cb_warbringer_gorrak.accept_text: North-east of here, at the Kolkar War Camp. Wait at the edge of it until the drum starts. Taskmasters first.

cb_lady_of_the_fang.accept_text: Into the Wailing Caverns, the cave mouth south-west of this oasis. She keeps the north platform of the Serpentbloom Cavern, above the river crossing.

cb_thunder_and_slumber.accept_text:
Back into the Wailing Caverns, south-west of the oasis, and deeper. Pythas is in the east gallery, Skum in the north.

Deviate ravagers run the galleries between the two.

cb_forgotten_pilgrims.turn_in_text:
Names.

People who walked all this way because they believed in something, and not one of them has been said out loud in forty years.

We'll carry the beads to Orgrimmar's shrine. They've earned that much.

cb_powder_kegs.turn_in_text:
Kegs, no fuses lit.

You may be the most careful soul in the Barrens. That's an excellent quality in a merchant.

Pity about the pay.

cb_imps_in_the_brush.turn_in_text:
Hm. Brimstone and blood.

They've been feeding the imps on something that was not an animal.

I'll send word to the Warchief.

cb_wardchief_thulg.turn_in_text:
The Razormane are leaderless.

That won't last. It never does. But it's a start and I haven't had one of those in a while.

cb_snapper_season.turn_in_text:
Plates thick as slabs.

This bridge will outlast us all now, which was the aim.

cb_dewdrops_of_the_dream.turn_in_text:
Drops, and not one spilled.

Look at what it shows. No - look properly, once, and then put it down.

The sleeper is not alone. The Fang have his ear.

cb_fang_and_flame.turn_in_text:
Shards. And they fit together.

One seal. One hand.

It's time to name the hand, and I find I've known it for a while.

cb_sentinel_stingers.accept_text:
The Sentinel Rocks, north-west of the Crossroads. In the crevices.

Their matriarch is the big one in the deepest crevice. The herd will not come back while she is there.

cb_weeping_pilgrim.accept_text:
The south pool at dusk. Be gentle about it.

The other drowned pilgrims walk with her. You will have to put them down to reach her.

cb_echo_of_the_fallen.accept_text:
At the shrine stone. Face him as an equal - and when he falls, tell him.

Mourning spirits gather round him. Lay those to rest first.

cb_cobrahn_and_kresh.accept_text:
The western ring - Cobrahn in his den, Kresh in the pool north of it.

Deviate shamblers hold the ring between them.

cb_kodo_graveyard.accept_text: The bowl east of the Sentinel Rocks. Wraiths first, then the horned one - the herders call him Hollowhorn.
